note: Simplified view of the SchoolFam prototype (github.com/abigailsadom1903/SchoolFam). It is a single-page React app: all logic runs in the browser and data is kept in browser storage, seeded with sample data.

nodes.title: React interface
nodes.summary: A single-page app with one screen per feature, built with React and TypeScript.
details: 21 feature components cover the daily feed, attendance, homework, pickup, health, chat, calendar, billing, shop, feedback and documents.
Charts for attendance and health use Recharts; icons use Lucide.

nodes.title: Role-based navigation
nodes.summary: One navigation list decides which screens each role sees: parent, teacher, admin or super admin.
details: Each menu item lists the roles allowed to see it, or 'all'.
For example, Classes is only for admins, while Homework and Moments are only for teachers and parents.

nodes.title: Sign-up & onboarding rules
nodes.summary: Controls who can join and how accounts are linked to students.
details: Teachers join with their staff ID (claiming a profile an admin created) or an active invite code for the teacher role; invite codes become 'used' after one sign-up.
Parents join with a student access code, which links their account to that child.

nodes.title: App state
nodes.summary: The top-level App component holds the app's data in React state and passes it down to each screen.
details: App.tsx uses 35 useState hooks for users, students, activities, invoices, messages and more.
Updates made on one screen, such as attendance, flow to the screens that display them.

nodes.title: AI service
nodes.summary: Builds a prompt from a child's recorded activities and asks Gemini for a parent-friendly daily summary.
details: Returns a friendly message instead of failing when the API key is missing or the request errors.

nodes.title: Browser storage
nodes.summary: Users, the class roster and invite codes are saved in the browser so they survive a page refresh.
details: Stored under three keys: schoolfam_users, schoolfam_roster and schoolfam_referral_codes.
Data stays on the device that created it; there is no server or shared database in the prototype.

nodes.title: Sample data
nodes.summary: Realistic demo records seed every feature so the prototype can be explored immediately.
details: constants.ts exports sample users, classes, students, activities, invoices, events, messages and more.

nodes.title: Gemini API
nodes.summary: Generates the Smart Daily Summary for parents.
details: Called directly from the browser; the key is injected at build time from GEMINI_API_KEY.

nodes.title: Pickup verification
nodes.summary: Captures a guardian's signature (and photo) when a child is collected.
details: The signature is drawn on a canvas and saved as a data URL on the pickup record, with the verifying teacher's name.

flows.title: Parent signs up with an access code

steps.text: A parent enters their details and the student access code from the school.
The code is looked up in the class roster; an unknown code is refused.
The matching student is linked to the new parent account.
Users and roster are saved to browser storage.
The parent sees the screens allowed for their role.

flows.title: Teacher joins with an enrolment code

steps.text: A teacher enters their staff ID or an invite code.
A staff ID claims the matching profile; otherwise the code must be an active teacher invite.
The invite code is marked as used so it cannot be reused.
Users and invite codes are saved to browser storage.

flows.title: Parent reads the AI daily summary

steps.text: The parent opens their child's Smart Summary.
Today's activities for that child are collected.
A prompt is built from the child's class and activities.
gemini-2.5-flash returns a summary in Markdown.
The summary is rendered with react-markdown.
A teacher opens Pickup and chooses the child and guardian.
The guardian signs on screen; the signature is saved as an image.
The pickup status changes to picked_up, with the verifying teacher's name.
